notes: T10 invites, channels, and forum topics over the existing HTTP SQLite store. MCP subtracts from the approved chigwell/telegram-mcp source-registration capture and now projects the previous 37 rows plus 10 invite/channel/forum source rows. Bot API setChatPhoto/deleteChatPhoto stay unimplemented. Album, host-upload, GIF, and photo-browser rows stay dropped.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.justification: Source-schema projection of seeded account labels and first-name profiles; unavailable phone and status values use the source fallbacks N/A and unknown.

tools.name: get_me
tools.justification: Source-schema projection of the signed-in seeded user.

tools.name: pin_message/unpin_message/unpin_all_messages/get_pinned_messages
tools.justification: Session-bound user operations over the shared persisted pin state.

tools.name: create_poll
tools.justification: Session-bound regular poll subset; source quiz and close-date forms are rejected.

tools.name: send_reaction/remove_reaction/get_message_reactions
tools.justification: Session-bound one-standard-emoji reaction subset; big animation is rejected.

tools.name: list_inline_buttons/press_inline_button
tools.justification: Observes and presses HTTP-created callback-data inline buttons, with persisted deterministic callback expiry/reset behavior.

tools.name: get_media_info/download_media
tools.justification: Chat-member download of visible message bytes from the existing SQLite store; destination host paths are refused and bytes return in the source string envelope. The tape stores download digests, not bytes.

tools.name: send_file/send_voice
tools.justification: User sends from the in-memory fixture catalog or an owned opaque file_id into the shared conversation store; URLs, host paths, and file_unique_id are refused.

tools.name: send_sticker/get_sticker_sets
tools.justification: Fixture sticker catalog only; unknown sticker paths are refused. HTTP sendSticker remains outside the Bot API subset.

tools.name: create_group/invite_to_group/leave_chat/get_participants
tools.justification: Session-bound group create, invite, leave, and paginated participant reads over persisted membership.

tools.name: edit_chat_title/edit_chat_about/edit_chat_photo/delete_chat_photo
tools.justification: Title, about, and fixture-catalog or owned file_id chat photos. HTTP setChatPhoto/deleteChatPhoto stay unimplemented.

tools.name: promote_admin/demote_admin/edit_admin_rights/get_admins
tools.justification: Admin rights are distinct from member restrictions; an actor cannot grant a right they lack.

tools.name: ban_user/unban_user/remove_user/get_banned_users
tools.justification: Ban, unban, and remove are different transitions.

tools.name: set_default_chat_permissions/toggle_slow_mode/get_recent_actions
tools.justification: Default permissions and slow mode use the injected clock; the admin log is permission-filtered.

tools.name: create_channel/subscribe_public_channel/search_public_chats
tools.justification: Public search is the seeded catalog only. Channel posts need creator status or can_post_messages.

tools.name: get_invite_link/export_chat_invite/import_chat_invite/join_chat_by_link
tools.justification: Invite tokens bind to chat and creator with expiry, use limit, and approval. External links are refused.

tools.name: list_topics/enable_forum_topics/create_forum_topic
tools.justification: Forum topics on a supergroup. Close is not delete; thread associations remain.

http.name: deleteMessage
http.justification: Own-message 48h bot window; group delete-others needs can_delete_messages.

http.name: getUpdates
http.justification: Durable per-bot update queue with offset acknowledgement.

http.name: setWebhook
http.justification: Durable bounded outbox with injected local delivery only.

http.name: deleteWebhook
http.justification: Disables webhook delivery and can drop queued updates.

http.name: getWebhookInfo
http.justification: Reports persisted webhook state and delivery errors.

http.name: sendPhoto/sendDocument/sendVideo/sendAudio/sendVoice
http.justification: HTTP-only bot-scoped SQLite media upload/reference subset.

http.name: getFile/file download
http.justification: Opaque expiring handles; member chat messages or chats.photo_file_id.

http.name: getChatAdministrators/getChatMemberCount/getChatMember
http.justification: Creator, administrator, member, restricted, left, and kicked are distinct.

http.name: setChatTitle/setChatDescription/setChatPermissions
http.justification: Default chat permissions are not per-member restrictions. use_independent_chat_permissions must be omitted or true. HTTP setChatPhoto/deleteChatPhoto stay unimplemented.

http.name: banChatMember/unbanChatMember/restrictChatMember/promoteChatMember/leaveChat
http.justification: Ban, unban, leave, invite, and remove remain different transitions. An actor cannot grant rights they lack. Supplied promote rights start from zero.

http.name: createChatInviteLink/editChatInviteLink/revokeChatInviteLink
http.justification: Tokens bind to chat and creator. Expiry uses the injected clock. Use limit and join-request cannot both be set.

http.name: approveChatJoinRequest/declineChatJoinRequest
http.justification: A pending request is not membership.

http.name: createForumTopic/editForumTopic/closeForumTopic/reopenForumTopic/deleteForumTopic
http.justification: Close is not delete. Messages keep their thread id after close or delete.
